name: Hindsight

faq.question: Hindsight says No model loaded (HTTP 400)
faq.answer: Start the LLM server and load the model, or enable Switch model by request in the server's API settings. The LLM model ID in Hindsight must match the ID the Models button lists.

description: Local memory API with ONNX embeddings, FlashRank and embedded PostgreSQL. Requires a running OpenAI-compatible LLM.

settings.label: Database URL
settings.help: Default: app-local embedded PostgreSQL. Do not put database credentials in this setting; Autark settings are not secret storage.

settings.label: LLM provider
settings.help: Use openai for Unsloth and other OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Other providers may require additional packages.

settings.label: LLM base URL
settings.help: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including /v1. Start the LLM server separately.

settings.label: LLM model ID
settings.help: Use the exact model ID served by your LLM endpoint.

settings.label: LLM API key file
settings.help: Type the full path to a UTF-8 file containing only the LLM key. Never enter the key itself here.

settings.label: LLM maximum concurrent requests
settings.help: Positive integer. Keep 1 for an LLM server that handles one request at a time.

settings.label: Embeddings provider
settings.help: This recipe installs ONNX support. Other providers may require additional packages and configuration.

settings.label: ONNX embedding model ID
settings.help: Hugging Face model ID. Changing this for existing data requires re-embedding, even if dimensions match.

settings.label: ONNX embedding dimensions
settings.help: Positive integer matching the selected embedding model. multilingual-e5-small uses 384.

settings.label: Reranker provider
settings.help: This recipe installs FlashRank support. Other providers may require additional packages and configuration.

settings.label: FlashRank cache folder
settings.help: Downloaded reranker models. The default keeps them inside this app's folder.

steps.name: Install Hindsight with ONNX, FlashRank and embedded PostgreSQL

run:
import os, sys
from pathlib import Path
try:
    key = Path(os.environ['AUTARK_HINDSIGHT_KEY_FILE']).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').strip()
except (OSError, UnicodeError):
    sys.exit('Cannot read the LLM API key file. Check the LLM API key file setting and UTF-8 encoding.')
if not key:
    sys.exit('The LLM API key file is empty.')
os.environ['HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_API_KEY'] = key
from hindsight_api.main import main
main()
